say: More than a billion years ago, two black holes were circling each other. Faster, and faster.

say: Then, in a fraction of a second, they collided. Three Suns' worth of mass, gone. Turned into pure ripples in spacetime.

The ripples raced outward at the speed of light, crossing the dark for more than a billion years.
